steps.action: Open Admin → Connect sidecar egress and confirm it reports that no outbound capability is granted yet, then open the credential-delivery page and confirm it refuses to promise delivery for the same reason.
steps.expectedResult: Both surfaces state, before anything is clicked, that this grain holds no outbound capability for the NamedCoin sidecar origin.

steps.action: Click Grant egress, choose “Use https://namedcoin.sidecar.host:9100” in the Melusina address selector (not the grain picker), and confirm the grant.
steps.expectedResult: The shell renders the ADDRESS SELECTOR scoped to that exact origin, the claim is saved as a durable sturdyref, and both surfaces now report the origin as granted.

steps.action: On the credential-delivery page choose Activate for tenant us.paype.cc against that sidecar origin.
steps.expectedResult: The pearl reaches the sidecar over the granted capability, both recipients return verified signed receipts, and the delivery commits ACTIVE — where before the grant the same click failed with an explicit no-outbound-capability refusal naming the origin.

steps.action: Ask the sidecar for its health and for one account-opening grant.
steps.expectedResult: Health no longer reports “tenant lease unavailable or expired”, and the account-opening grant endpoint issues a grant instead of 503.

steps.action: Install this release from Bazaar and use the rendered shell controls to upgrade the configured NamedCoin Admin grain.
steps.expectedResult: The tenant package, owner launch pin, and existing grain all report version 0.1.38 / appVersion 41, and the configured issuer remains enabled after the cold restart.

steps.action: Open the NamedCoin account-opening surface as an administrator.
steps.expectedResult: The page lists only fully verified, durably stored respondent identity material and offers no way to synthesize an identity outcome.

steps.action: Prepare one handoff from the exact verified material using explicit case, application, relationship, and wallet-binding identifiers.
steps.expectedResult: The app preflights the signed authority, evidence source, KYC, consent, storage receipt, tenant, issuer, wallet, expiry, and revocation bindings, then persists one exact signed handoff before opening a picker.

steps.action: Click Select participant and open case, choose the already-enrolled MSB Domain Template participant in the Powerbox, and confirm the provider grant.
steps.expectedResult: The case-bound outcome ingress is acquired and saved, the exact signed outcome is submitted, and the page renders application_received from the selected participant.

steps.action: Restart NamedCoin Admin, Domain Template, and the selected Popaye grain through their shell Restart controls, then reopen the durable handoff and participant account-opening status.
steps.expectedResult: The same handoff remains completed, the participant remains enrolled, Popaye remains at application_received or a later valid phase, and no duplicate case or outcome is created.
